data_fields.name: drop_roll_amount
data_fields.donor_constant: dropAmount from the change mode, each drop row rolled that many times

best_idea: Charge tool wear per effective use. A break needs tool damage above the block's resistance, an effective tool pays one durability, the server checks and swaps the block first and only then writes the wear, and the write keeps the old value so a refused command can roll it back.
decision_why: The server gate, then the swap, then the wear write, with a stored previous value for rollback, gives gear wear a server-verified ledger entry that costs nothing when a hit or break is refused; the grid-built stats are a separate idea for gear grades and the creative bypass is rejected because no fight mode is creative.
acceptance: A server test: a tool with durability 3 used on three effective breaks is removed on the third; a break refused by the block check leaves durability unchanged; a command rejected after the wear step restores the previous durability; the player sees the durability bar step down once per effective break and the item vanish at zero.
